entry_points.text: Signalfd operations dispatch release, poll, vector read and no-op seek with optional fdinfo; native and compat calls validate mask size, copy mask and delegate to shared creation, with zero flags for legacy forms.
Tee, splice and vmsplice validate flags, short-circuit zero length, resolve descriptors, import vectors and choose direction by mode, delegating to shared dispatch, fill or drain.
Old, new, 64-bit stat and statx resolve names, links, descriptors or dfd-relative names via VFS then convert; statx uses fd helper when name is absent with valid dfd and automount suppressed.
Native and compat pathname and descriptor statfs fetch via shared lookup then render through native, sized or compat copiers, with 64-bit forms enforcing exact size match.

exports.text: Seq hash start maps offset to RCU iteration with zero as start marker; seq cache is created at boot with accounting, panicking on failure.

Signalfd wakes poll-free waiters on sighand teardown; create and update validate flags, exclude uncatchable signals, store inverted mask, make anonymous file or replace mask and wake waiters. Flags reuse cloexec and nonblock values.

Tee duplicates pipes without page copy, needs distinct pipes and modes, propagates nonblock and preps both ends; stack helpers copy size, blocks and full attrs; statx fillers map immutable and append and atomic-write limits when minimum is nonzero.
VFS stat offers fd, dfd-relative, pathname and follow variants converging on dfd lookup with basic stats; path and fd statx validate mask and sync mode, strip kernel-only cookie, query and format.
Compat classic, link, dfd-relative and fd stat fetch via VFS then format through shared compat copier, returning first error.

Super lookup by device returns first lockable match with extra reference; statfs needs filesystem operation, clears destination, checks security, defaults fragment size and adds mount flags; fd variant needs open file; fsid helper extracts identifier.

hazards.text: Pipe to file warns if destination writes more than prepared, indicating overrun.

Missing readers yield pipe signal plus error; missing writers end input wait quietly; nonblock yields retry, signals yield restart and copy or buffer failures yield fault; truncated folios yield short or empty input.
Stat and readlink fail with overflow on narrow fields, fault on bad user copy and reject bad sizes and types; old-stat warnings are bounded to five.
Statfs rendering fails with overflow on narrowed counts, tolerating all-ones unknown file count; superblock RCU teardown defers freeing to workqueue.

invariants.text: Signalfd release frees context and succeeds; poll registers on sighand queue and reports readable when private or shared pending hit mask; copy selects fields by kind; read needs one 128 byte record, moves whole records and blocks only first wait; fdinfo shows complement mask.

Pipe confirm succeeds if uptodate else locks folio to separate truncation with no data from IO error; release drops page reference and LRU mark; user steal needs gift flag; acquire delegates to operation vector; nowait clear uses compare-exchange retry.

Splice to pipe and append fail with pipe error when readerless or full and free input; page arrays stay inline to pipe capacity; iterator packs user pages in batches and reverts unfinished span on failure; descriptors carry lengths, flags and iterator, buffers carry page, offset, length, flags and ops.

General splice validates modes, rejects pipe offsets, forbids self and append, checks pread and pwrite capability and ranges, propagates nonblock, updates positions and notifies modify then access; pipe to file and socket confirm, bound writes, consume and wake; dispatch copies offsets with fault; prep waits check signals, nonblock and readers.

Statx maps follow and automount unless nofollow or no-automount, rejects flags outside supported set; path helper collects attributes then records unique or legacy mount identifier with root annotation; conversion zeroes destination, hides kernel bits, munges identifiers, splits device and copies times and sizes.

Old, new, 64-bit and compat converters zero destination, encode devices, check inode, link, device and size limits, munge identifiers, copy times, size and blocks and fault on bad copy; records carry device, inode, mode, owners, size, times, blocks, attributes, mount and atomic-write limits; readlink checks size and permission, updates access time and retries stale handles.

Mount and superblock options project to statfs flags with validity marker; sized variants reject size mismatch; legacy ustat resolves superblock from device number, queries root and returns free blocks and inodes zeroed with 32-bit clamp.

Byte accounting uses 512 byte units with carry and borrow; locked wrappers serialize while unlocked helpers need held lock; reclaim count avoids lock, stays empty until born and sums populations; retire needs block backing and exclusive lock; type iteration skips dying instances with reference handoff.

locks.text: Signalfd poll, dequeue and mask update hold sighand interrupt-disabling spin protection over pending sets and mask.
Pipe splice holds pipe mutex across wait, inspection and move; dual-pipe transfers order locks by address.

Inode bytes use per-inode spin lock; stack size copy uses conditional spin for wide counters; superblock list uses dedicated spin with shared and exclusive lifetime locks; device walks use RCU with pin handoff.

state_machines.text: Signal dequeue is immediate with retry on empty, or interruptible wait until selected signal arrives or foreign signal forces restart.

Pipe to pipe moves whole buffers when covered else shares stripped prefix; it retries preparation on peer race with no progress, holding both locks only while moving; linking stops on done, drained, full, reader loss or failed reference, piping error only with zero progress.
Reclaim scan refuses when filesystem activity is barred or shared lock is busy, splits scan across directory, inode and filesystem sets with minimal progress and prunes in that order.

structs.text: Signalfd context holds selected mask; pipe operation tables mix confirm, release and get with steal variants, with no-steal omitting steal.

Device record holds device, superblock, pin count, hash linkage and RCU head; table is resizable device-keyed hash with key and link offsets; wake on born, dying and dead; iteration bits exclusive, unlocked and reverse; freeze writers normal, fault and internal.
